post.topic: Automating Missed Call Lead Capture for Local Businesses
post.headline: Stop Losing Clients to Unanswered Phone Calls
post.subline: Turn missed calls into booked appointments instantly with automated SMS follow-ups that capture leads 24/7.
post.caption:
Every missed call is a customer walking straight to your competitor.

When you are busy with a client or closed for the evening, incoming calls go to voicemail. Most people won't leave a message—they just call the next business on Google.

The fix is an automated missed-call text-back system.

The moment a call goes unanswered, an automated workflow instantly texts the caller, answers basic inquiries, and provides a scheduling link.

Practical Tip: Set up an instant automated SMS trigger for unanswered calls asking, "Sorry we missed your call! How can we help you today?" to capture intent before they leave.

Ready to stop losing leads? DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call.
post.insight_note: This post targets local service businesses and clinics by addressing a direct revenue loss caused by unhandled incoming phone calls during peak hours.

reel.insight_note: Gyms and spas lose high-intent prospects when trial requests sit unaddressed for hours, making instant automated SMS follow-up an easy high-ROI solution.
reel.caption:
Are you losing potential gym members after they claim a free trial pass?

When someone requests a pass online, waiting hours to text them kills their excitement.

Here is how automation fixes it:
1. Lead fills out a form.
2. AI immediately texts them a booking link.
3. Automated reminders follow up if they do not book.

Quick tip for today: Set up an automated SMS reply inside your form builder so leads get a booking link within 60 seconds.
